name: Omaforge Local Control Center
author: eddieor
description: Start, stop, restart, and watch logs for one local project's dev services.

barWidget.description: Monitor and control local development processes (dev servers, workers) for a project, defined by .omaforge/services.json in the project directory.

schema.label: Project directory
schema.description: A local git project containing .omaforge/services.json. Add another instance of this widget for each project you want to monitor.
